name: dataDogs
description: Data Hunt — dogs hunt data: Kennels, Waves, Serialized TypeScript in the void. Express, Angular, Prisma.

scripts.build:dogs: npm run build:dogs-demo && npm run build:dogs-geo && npm run build:dogs-warframe && npm run build:dogs-hue && npm run build:dogs-talking && npm run build:dogs-public-transport && npm run build:dogs-weather && npm run build:dogs-air-quality && npm run build:dogs-geocoding && npm run build:dogs-wikipedia && npm run build:dogs-sun && npm run build:dogs-biodiversity && npm run build:dogs-birds && npm run build:dogs-phenology && npm run build:dogs-webcams && npm run build:dogs-regional-news && npm run build:dogs-transit-trips && npm run build:dogs-astronomy && npm run build:dogs-water && npm run build:dogs-historical-weather && npm run build:dogs-charging && npm run build:dogs-currency && npm run build:dogs-holidays && npm run build:dogs-wiki-search && npm run build:dogs-season && npm run build:dogs-ip-geo && npm run build:dogs-random-fact && npm run build:dogs-space && npm run build:dogs-open-library && npm run build:dogs-github-trending && npm run build:dogs-humor && npm run build:dogs-animals-random && npm run build:dogs-dictionary && npm run build:dogs-knowledge && npm run build:dogs-pop-culture && npm run build:dogs-music && npm run build:dogs-sports && npm run build:dogs-dev && npm run build:dogs-travel && npm run build:dogs-quiz && npm run build:dogs-religion && npm run build:dogs-health && npm run build:dogs-cuisine && npm run build:dogs-web-archive && npm run build:dogs-images && npm run build:dogs-name-insights && npm run build:dogs-gaming && npm run build:dogs-translate && npm run build:dogs-tv && npm run build:dogs-social && npm run build:dogs-crypto
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build:geo-pact && npm run build:swaggrid && npm run build:dogs
scripts.dev: npm run prisma:sync && node scripts/inject-ui-api-base.cjs && concurrently -n backend,ui -c blue,green "cross-env NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register main.ts" "npm run ui"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register main.ts
scripts.start:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs ./scripts/prisma-generate-matching-env.cjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs dist/main.js
scripts.start:integration: npm run prisma:sync:integration && cross-env NODE_ENV=integration node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register main.ts
scripts.start:integration:dist: npm run prisma:sync:integration && cross-env NODE_ENV=integration node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs dist/main.js
scripts.ui: node scripts/inject-ui-api-base.cjs && cd ui-app && npx ng serve --proxy-config proxy.conf.js --open
scripts.ui:build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production node scripts/inject-ui-api-base.cjs && cd ui-app && npx ng build
scripts.ui:build:integration: cross-env NODE_ENV=integration node scripts/inject-ui-api-base.cjs && cd ui-app && npx ng build
scripts.render:integration:build: npm install && npm run build:prod && npm run ui:build:integration && npm run prisma:sync:integration
scripts.typecheck:dogs: cd packages/dogs-demo && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-geo && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-warframe && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-hue && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-talking && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-public-transport && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-weather && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-air-quality && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-geocoding && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-wikipedia && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-sun && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-biodiversity && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-birds && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-phenology && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-webcams && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-regional-news && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-transit-trips && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:dogs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:integration-dogs

author: Martin

prisma.seed: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r ./scripts/load-env.cjs -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register seed-data/seed.ts
